archetype: Premium editorial photo journal, Digital family archive, Subtle Vietnamese heritage

headings.usage_rules: Use for all editorial headings. Emphasize italics for subtitles. Track tightly (-0.02em) for large sizes.

body.usage_rules: Use for UI elements, labels, and paragraph text. Render Vietnamese diacritics excellently. Generous line height (1.6+). Avoid tiny captions (<14px) for accessibility.

colors.usage_rules: Do not use blue-purple gradients, glassmorphism, or sepia filters. Muted brass for Memorial section. Never communicate status through color alone.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Restrained, subtle shadows. Avoid large diffused drop shadows. Think 'paper lying on paper'. Use 1px borders of #E9E1D3 for definition.
visual_enhancers.borders: Thin dividers (1px solid #E9E1D3 or #B89656/30). Avoid excessive rounded cards (use 0px, 2px, or max 4px border radius).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle paper-like surfaces. Use solid background colors, no gradients.
visual_enhancers.photography: Photography is hero. Preserve aspect ratios. DO NOT crop faces (use object-fit: contain or smart crop). No chaotic masonry, use controlled editorial grids. Spotlight/clipped frames allowed.

layouts.grid: Editorial grid. Use negative space. Content must feel curated, not dumped.
layouts.navigation_desktop: Minimal top nav. Visually distinct 'Đăng kỷ niệm' CTA. Secondary user menu.
layouts.navigation_mobile: Mobile-first. Bottom navigation with max 5 destinations (Trang nhà, Dòng thời gian, Gia đình, Album, Tưởng nhớ). Min 44px touch targets. No hover-dependent interactions.
layouts.spacing: Generous whitespace. Double standard padding (e.g. p-8, p-12).

motion.general: Restrained 180-300ms. Gentle fade/reveal. Motion must never block reading.
motion.hero_moment: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load. Slow editorial marquee.

components.buttons: Large clear controls. Solid background (#183153) with white text, or outline with thin border. Pill or slight rounding.
components.cards: Subtle paper-like. No excessive rounding. No heavy shadows.
components.forms: Large inputs. Clear labels in Be Vietnam Pro. Clear error/success states.

key_sections.hero: Editorial hero featuring one family memory ('Hôm nay trong ký ức'). Signature on-load hero moment.
key_sections.timeline: 'Dòng thời gian' across years and decades. Lightweight filters.
key_sections.memorial: Restrained memorial section ('Tưởng nhớ'). Quiet, dignified, warm. Use muted brass. Avoid dark funeral imagery.
key_sections.upload_flow: Mobile-first upload flow: select -> preview -> caption -> date -> event -> branch -> review. With states (progress/success/error).

hero_memory.description: Four people in traditional vietnamese clothing sitting together

accessibility.focus: Visible keyboard focus states on all interactive elements.
accessibility.structure: Semantic headings. Meaningful alt-text for all images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a premium editorial photo journal suitable for a Vietnamese extended family.
Use EXACT color codes provided: Warm ivory #F7F2E8, Soft ink #20201D, Heritage navy #183153, Lacquer red #9B3A32, Muted brass #B89656, Parchment #E9E1D3, Moss green #456B58.
Implement Newsreader for headings and Be Vietnam Pro for body.
Create a clean, paper-like UI. DO NOT use glassmorphism, heavy drop shadows, sepia filters, or blue-purple gradients.
Ensure the hero section features a masked line-by-line reveal animation.
Include a slow editorial marquee and numbered chapters if applicable.
Mobile bottom navigation is mandatory with exactly 5 items.
Ensure all text is large and readable (older audience). Minimum touch target is 44px.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling and framer-motion for restrained entrance animations.
Do not crop faces in photography; use appropriate aspect ratios.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grid-based editorial structures.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NEVER use placeholder text or dummy image URLs.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
